journey.name: Mellorine: añadir nata deja la receta disponible
journey.description: Con los datos de ejemplo falta la nata para "Mellorine para Nami y Robin" (etiqueta "Falta 1 ingrediente"). Al añadir 250 ml de nata a la despensa, la etiqueta de la receta pasa a "Disponible".

actions.action: Scroll down the list of recipes until the card "Mellorine para Nami y Robin" is fully visible
Verify that the card "Mellorine para Nami y Robin" shows the label "Falta 1 ingrediente"
Tap the "Despensa" tab in the bottom navigation bar
Tap the "Ingrediente" field and choose "Nata" from the list
Verify that the pantry list shows the text "Nata · 250 ml"
Tap the "Recetas" tab in the bottom navigation bar
Scroll down the list of recipes until the card "Mellorine para Nami y Robin" is fully visible
Verify that the card "Mellorine para Nami y Robin" shows the label "Disponible" and no longer "Falta 1 ingrediente"
